description: Supported blockchain networks and initial token registry for LumiBase v0.1. Base Mainnet is configured but disabled; enabling it is a deliberate change requiring completion of Phase 10 and Phase 12.
notes: RPC URLs are intentionally omitted from this file. They are per-environment configuration, not protocol constants, and must be supplied via environment variables.

The 12-block threshold is a conservative v0.1 default (approximately 24 seconds on Base). Base finality is ultimately derived from Ethereum L1; integrations with higher assurance requirements may raise this threshold, and v0.2 will introduce an explicit L1-finality policy.
Base Mainnet and its USDC token MUST remain disabled until the complete payment flow (Phase 10) and release checklist (Phase 12) are verified.
USDC addresses are the canonical Base deployments published by Circle.
